_comment: The table that pins the two implementations of toStoreName to each other: kiao-worker/src/utils.ts (what Dashboard and kiao-mcp name a NEW document's folder with) and migrations/lib/store-name.js (what a migration renames an EXISTING one with). Both test suites read this file, so a change to the rule goes here first. `fallback` is what an unusable title resolves to; every case passes the same one so the table stays readable. Control characters are written as \u escapes.

cases.why: a title a path can carry is kept exactly as it reads
cases.title: Doux comme le miel
cases.name: Doux comme le miel
